notes: Account background: large regional health system focused on inpatient/outpatient notes, pathology reports, and imaging narratives.
Corpus scope: ~18M raw encounter notes; expect ~60M embedding vectors after chunking (200-400 tokens/window).
Scale ask: initial pilot 10M vectors, plan to index full 60M in 3-6 months; long term growth estimate +25%/yr.
Performance targets: 95th P2P retrieval + rerank <250ms; tail <500ms for critical clinician flows; throughput target 150 QPS for peak search API.
Cost objective: target cost per end-to-end query (retrieval + rerank + embedding if needed) <$0.03 at volume; POC to produce run-rate estimate.
Model preference: open-models acceptable if hosted privately; customer wants ability to pin quantized reranker model on dedicated infra.
Reranking requirement: clinical-grade relevance, evidence attribution, prefer reranker that can prioritize clinical guidelines and suppress hallucinations.
Security: BAA required, full audit logs for all access to PHI, KMS/HSM for key management, must support customer-managed keys and retention controls.
Networking: strict VPC peering or private link; no public internet egress for PHI payloads; on-prem option for high-risk cohorts.
Compliance ask: SOC2 + ISO27001 preferred; detailed answers requested on retention and data residency for NY/NJ patient records.
Integrations: Epic (HL7/FHIR) connectors planned; expecting Redwood to hand off vector store snapshots to existing search pipeline (Elasticsearch for metadata).
Quote from chief data scientist: "We need clinical reliability more than fancy LLM tricks — relevance and traceability are must-haves."
POC scope: ingest 250k sample notes, run embeddings + sparse candidate retrieval + reranker; measure latency, recall@10, cost per 1k queries.
Customer requests: sample SOW, network diagram review, pricing scenarios for Dedicated vs Private (on-prem), and a template BAA.
Risk note: internal security asks for proof that Redwood can rotate keys and provide immutable audit stream for 7 years — flagged as potential blocker.
Next steps: finalize SOW, security questionnaire answers, schedule on-site workshop, legal to review BAA (est. 3-4 weeks).
